skill_name: Client-Side Data Fetching, Offline Storage & Security
question_text: Write an ANSI SQL query to audit active un-stale client storage items by category from `client_cached_items_28`.
correct_answer:
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS fresh_entries, MAX(cache_timestamp) AS latest_sync
FROM client_cached_items_28
WHERE is_stale = 0
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY latest_sync DESC;
answer_explanation: Filters for valid unexpired client cache entries, groups by category, and returns latest synchronization timestamps.
